text: {"lessons":["I should not react to short-term account declines by making rushed trades; I made no trades in the first two down periods, and those moves alone did not tell me what to buy or sell.","Buying more after prices fell felt like taking advantage of lower prices, but I should check each stock’s prospects and my portfolio exposure rather than assume a dip will reverse.","My account value rose in Period 5, but that short-term gain does not prove my trades were wise; I should judge decisions by a consistent long-term plan for my apartment goal."]}
